implemented_requirements.requirement: Generate Fibonacci numbers up to a given number (inclusive)
implemented_requirements.evidence: fibonacci.py → generate_fibonacci(limit) returns a list of all Fibonacci numbers ≤ limit; fibonacci_generator(limit) yields the same sequence lazily. cli.py uses these functions to display the numbers.

critical_issues: cli.py does not contain a `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard, so running the file directly will not execute the program.
The test suite is placed in main.py but the module docstring refers to it as test_fibonacci.py, which could cause confusion when locating tests.
judge.summary: The submitted code provides a complete, correct implementation for generating Fibonacci numbers up to a user‑specified limit, both as a list and as a lazy generator. Input validation utilities and a fully‑featured CLI (argument parsing, interactive prompting, optional count and streaming modes) are present. Minor usability issues (missing entry‑point guard in cli.py and a mismatched test file name) do not affect the core functionality, so the overall solution meets the benchmark requirements.
